summary: The StudentAssessments file contains code for managing student assessments within an HSPnet application. It includes functionalities such as loading assessment data, generating reports, sorting data, and handling user interactions.
purpose: To provide an interface for managing student assessments, including viewing, downloading, and sorting assessment information.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Check if page is a postback.
Set ViewState 'FirstDataLoad' to '1' if not a postback.
Refresh data if UserSession exists and 'FirstDataLoad' is '1'.

workflows.name: Refresh
steps: Set visibility of Generate Report button.
Fill course and assessment template dropdowns.
Display grid data if data binding is true.

workflows.name: Generate Report
steps: Generate CSV report if data is available.
Set report HTML and file name, and make download link visible.

business_rules: Screen is editable if 'btnGenerateReport.Visible' is true.
validations: Check if UserSession is null before proceeding with data operations.
calculations: Calculate and set CSS classes for grid rows during data binding.
conditions: Check if page is not a postback to initialize data.
Check if selected template value is 'ALL' to determine assessment template code.
system_behavior: On dataset binding, grid data is displayed.
User actions trigger postbacks that refresh data.
dependencies: SQL data access for retrieving assessment data.
